items.title: Veeva Systems (VEEV) Becomes Core CRM Choice For Major Biopharma AI Rollout
items.summary: Veeva Systems (NYSE:VEEV) said UCB has selected Veeva Vault CRM as a key platform for its commercial operations. UCB plans to use industry-specific AI within Vault CRM to support product launches and day-to-day customer engagement in life sciences markets. The rollout positions Vault CRM as a core system for UCB's commercial teams, with a focus on generating real-world commercial evidence.
